hypothesis: Adding a hyper-reduced, deployment-visible discrete wave-equation residual to the causal coefficient solve will improve future-field relative L2, especially on Marmousi, compared with an otherwise identical observation-and-bridge-only rank-32 CPADC solve.

mechanism.online_operator: second-order-in-time interior LWC operator with the registered radius-four eighth-order spatial stencil
mechanism.offline_operator: source-consistent saved-grid LWC84 CFS-CPML arrival-window loss
mechanism.safety: ridge regularization, learned correction-energy ball, condition/effective-rank gates, calibrated abstention, and exact no-op through the two observed frames

motivation_from_frozen_r7_test_id.interpretation: The rank-16 solve reaches its correction cap and solves its causal objective, but that objective is nearly uninformative for Marmousi future error; more iterations on the same quadratic cannot fix this mismatch.

parent_binding.launch_requirement: Replace the template with the final accepted refined parent and record its SHA-256 before any long training or holdout evaluation.

feasibility_pilot.purpose: Reject or retain the new sparse physics objective before the paired A/B experiment; this pilot is not promotion evidence.
feasibility_pilot.success_signal: finite complete checkpoint plus positive paired train-patch relative improvement over the frozen parent
feasibility_pilot.failure_signal: nonfinite solve, inner rejection, nonpositive paired train-patch improvement, or resource failure
feasibility_pilot.patch_size_correction_note: Actual queued pilots (r4/r5 on 2026-08-15) ran with patch_size=201 because pde_cpml in the bound config requires the complete 201x201 grid; the original 96 was a pre-CPML legacy value that failed the static contract check twice (r1 warmup gate on 2026-08-14, r2 CPML grid gate on 2026-08-15). Corrected on 2026-08-16 by Claude Code audit; no external sha256 binding references this file.

feasibility_attempt_history.cause: The one-epoch CLI override inherited the production warmup_epochs=10, violating warmup_epochs < total_epochs.
feasibility_attempt_history.evidence: queue_terminal.json reports torchrun_return_code=1 and train.log reports CPADC warmup must be shorter than the training horizon on all four ranks.

feasibility_attempt_history.schedule_amendment: Explicit CLI warmup_epochs=0 for the one-epoch feasibility horizon; production warmup remains 10/160 epochs.

queue_submission.interference_policy: The queue only reads nvidia-smi and waits while any compute PID exists; it never sends signals, restarts jobs, or changes process priority.

paired_ablation.semantic_difference: Only online_inner_weights.defect changes from 1.0 to 0.0; all other parsed YAML values are identical.

trainonly_paired_evaluation.selection: group-disjoint train records excluded from the actual four-per-family basis pilot

evidence_ladder.evidence: Sparse operator rows match direct materialization; synthetic in-basis coefficient recovery passes; invalid CPML/fourth-order use fails closed; 43 focused tests pass after the scheduler repair, exact train-exclusion override, and paired-gate addition (the earlier broader 53-test suite also passed).

evidence_ladder.experiment: Same-parent train-only A/B pilot: observation-and-bridge-only rank-32 CPADC versus CPADC-LSPG-RAD-r1, with one conceptual change in the online inner objective.
Group-disjoint train confirmation and risk calibration with 64 records per family.
One independent complete test_id confirmation without tuning.

primary_metric: paired mean per-record future-field relative-L2 improvement over the same-parent rank-32 observation-and-bridge-only ablation on disjoint train confirmation
secondary_metrics: aggregate and per-family future relative L2
mean and P95 complete adaptation runtime
effective design rank and correction-energy saturation
failure_signals: The train-only paired gain over the observation-and-bridge ablation is below 1 percentage point.
Marmousi gains remain below 0.5 percentage points or its objective-error correlation remains nonpositive.
The nonworse fraction falls below 95 percent or any family mean regresses.
Measured P95 adaptation exceeds 2.5 seconds on the deployment CPU path.
The effective design rank is below 24 on more than 5 percent of records.
Corrections repeatedly saturate the energy ball without improving future error.

compute_budget.train_only_pilot: 12 records per family, one short run per A/B arm
compute_budget.train_only_confirmation: 64 group-disjoint records per family after pilot hyperparameters are frozen
compute_budget.validation: one complete 480-record run only after train-only promotion
compute_budget.test_id: one complete independent run only after validation promotion

rollback: Keep the v5 observation-and-bridge solve as the default for existing checkpoints. If any train-only gate fails, reject v6, preserve all artifacts, and do not open validation or test_id.

safe_cpu_microbenchmark.scope: synthetic performance/contract check only; not accuracy evidence
